headline: US forces global shutdown of Fable 5; Gatekeeper slumps
body: Days after launch, the US government issued an emergency export-control directive barring foreign nationals from using Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 over a reported jailbreak. Anthropic disabled both models for all customers worldwide and disputed the basis. A unilateral, sudden clampdown hurts Global Coordination, which drags down Gatekeeper and lifts Self-Destruction; pulling frontier models also slows Capability Velocity, which raises Reversion. The same day, SpaceX, which absorbed xAI, listed on Nasdaq at about $1.75T in the largest IPO ever, a jump in Power Concentration that weighs on Libertarian Utopia. Security worries added up: CISA cut federal patch windows to three days because AI speeds up attacks, and researchers showed 'agentjacking' of coding agents. Horizon Balance fell 0.44 to 1.8.
movers_note: Gatekeeper -1.5, from the Fable 5 shutdown directive (-1.47); Self-Destruction +0.9, from the directive (+0.76) and CISA's patch order (+0.16); Libertarian Utopia -0.6, mostly from the SpaceX IPO (-0.48).
